 Nitto ATP Finals 
 What are the Nitto ATP Finals semi-final qualification scenarios?
 16 November 2026 
 By ATP Staff 
 © Corinne Dubreuil & Jack Howell/ATP Tour 
 Alexander Zverev and Carlos Alcaraz have both won their openers this year in Turin. 
 Share:
 Zverev, Alcaraz send early statement with opening wins 
 After two days of competition at the Nitto ATP Finals in Turin, the semi-final qualification scenarios have taken shape. 
 Top four seeds Alexander Zverev, Carlos Alcaraz, Ben Shelton and Daniil Medvedev have all won their opening matches at the season finale, and at least one of them could qualify for the semi-finals in the next two days.
 View below full Nitto ATP Finals semi-final qualification scenarios as of 16 November.
 Singles John McEnroe Group qualification scenarios after the completion of the 1st round of the event's group stage: 
 Alexander Zverev qualifies on Tuesday if:
 - Alexander Zverev defeats Ben Shelton in 2 sets.
 - Alexander Zverev defeats Ben Shelton and Rafael Jodar defeats Arthur Fils.
 Ben Shelton qualifies on Tuesday if:
 - Ben Shelton defeats Alexander Zverev and Arthur Fils defeats Rafael Jodar.
 Singles Ivan Lendl Group qualification scenarios after the completion of the 1st round of the event's group stage: 
 Carlos Alcaraz qualifies on Wednesday if:
 - Carlos Alcaraz defeats Daniil Medvedev and Frances Tiafoe defeats Flavio Cobolli.
 - Carlos Alcaraz defeats Daniil Medvedev in 2 sets and Flavio Cobolli defeats Frances Tiafoe in 3 sets.
 Daniil Medvedev qualifies on Wednesday if:
 - Daniil Medvedev defeats Carlos Alcaraz and Flavio Cobolli defeats Frances Tiafoe.
 - Daniil Medvedev defeats Carlos Alcaraz in 2 sets and Frances Tiafoe defeats Flavio Cobolli in 3 sets.
 Doubles Todd Woodbridge Group qualification scenarios after the completion of the 1st round of the event's group stage: 
 Harri Heliovaara / Henry Patten qualify on Tuesday if:
 - Harri Heliovaara / Henry Patten defeat Marcelo Arevalo / Mate Pavic and Orlando Luz / Rafael Matos defeat Theo Arribage / AIbano Olivetti.
 Marcelo Arevalo / Mate Pavic qualify on Tuesday if:
 - Marcelo Arevalo / Mate Pavic defeat Harri Heliovaara / Henry Patten in 2 sets.
 - Marcelo Arevalo / Mate Pavicdefeat Harri Heliovaara / Henry Patten and Theo Arribage / AIbano Olivetti defeat Orlando Luz / Rafael Matos. 
 Doubles Mark Woodforde Group qualification scenarios after the completion of the 1st round of the event's group stage: 
 Marcel Granollers / Horacio Zeballos qualify on Wednesday if:
 - Marcel Granollers / Horacio Zeballos defeat Kevin Krawietz / Tim Puetz and Simone Bolelli / Andrea Vavassori defeat Christian Harrison / Neal Skupski.
 - Marcel Granollers / Horacio Zeballos defeat Kevin Krawietz / Tim Puetz in 2 sets and Christian Harrison / Neal Skupski defeat Simone Bolelli / Andrea Vavassori in 3 sets.
 Kevin Krawietz / Tim Puetz qualify on Wednesday if:
 - Kevin Krawietz / Tim Puetz defeat Marcel Granollers / Horacio Zeballos and Christian Harrison / Neal Skupski defeat Simone Bolelli / Andrea Vavassori.
 - Kevin Krawietz / Tim Puetz defeat Marcel Granollers / Horacio Zeballos in 2 sets and Simone Bolelli / Andrea Vavassori defeat Christian Harrison / Neal Skupski in 3 sets.
